results.rationale: Consistency: the white pointed pump, slim heel, tan sole edge and profile are preserved; added poster setting is authorized. Instruction: gold decoration, gray-white gradient, prominent shoe and both phrases appear, but title uses mixed case italic serif rather than bold uppercase and lacks a clear shadow. Quality: coherent shoe curves and polished, legible poster graphics.

Consistency: cabinet shape, three drawers, knobs and trim remain; the paint surface gains a slight speckled texture. Instruction: warm wall, wood floor, curtain, left placement and lower-right text are present, but the slogan is badly corrupted with 'Noty', 'Not ornly stems' and overlapping letters, and right blank space is limited. Quality: coherent furniture and room, but multiple malformed/overlapping words are distracting and semantically degraded.
